atlas: Allen Developing Mouse Brain Atlas, DevMouse2012
hemisphere: Official unilateral annotation only; not mirrored
coordinateSpace: Stage-specific cropped reference, not adult CCF or Bregma

meshFormat.name: allen-mesh-v1
meshFormat.processing: Marching cubes at 0.5 on the resampled label mask; no smoothing, mirroring or mesh interpolation across stages.

provenance.processing: Crop official brain and brain-ventricle labels; omit spinal cord/body/tract-only labels. Resample grayscale with trilinear interpolation and labels with nearest neighbour onto a 40 micrometer isotropic grid. Preserve grayscale polarity and the native 0-255 intensity scale, promote uint8 to uint16 and set voxels outside retained labels to zero. No synthetic or mirrored tissue.
provenance.orientationNote: Allen documentation explicitly defines these raw reference volumes as PIR, +x posterior, +y inferior, +z right. We preserve raw axis order. Original MetaImage headers contain AnatomicalOrientation=RAI and identity TransformMatrix; that header token is retained for audit rather than used to override the documented raw array convention.
provenance.limitations: Single-specimen, stage-specific reconstruction. Annotation derives from spaced sagittal atlas drawings interpolated by Allen. Native reconstruction spacing and 40 micrometer display sampling do not imply equally fine anatomical boundary accuracy. Only the source annotated hemisphere is shown; no cross-stage pointwise registration or stereotaxic use.

reference.authors: Thompson CL, Ng L, Menon V, et al.
reference.title: A high-resolution spatiotemporal atlas of gene expression of the developing mouse brain
